note: 最小权限变更十段中英草稿。撤权前检查依赖和审计覆盖，灰度误伤仅修复必要权限；未配音，无虚构时间轴。

series.title: 最小权限收敛：审计依赖与灰度误伤
series.premise: 导出服务共享角色权限过宽，拟拆分读取与写入职责，但月底任务依赖尚未完全核实。
series.outcome: 通过九十天日志及任务负责人核对依赖，灰度撤权发现失败文件隔离路径漏列。暂停扩大，批准限定隔离前缀写入；验证正常、拒绝及月底模拟路径后分批收敛，保留短期例外的到期复查。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

recycling.note: 未来候选非实际复现；旧表达限既有库、S03–S07及本文件已引入项。

dialogues.title: 过宽权限先盘点后撤销
dialogues.premise: 评审导出服务共享角色，尚未批准生产撤权。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出权限风险与未经验证不能立即撤权的原因。

lines.en: Least privilege isn't met here. The export role can write across buckets.
lines.zh: 这里不满足最小权限，导出角色可以跨桶写入。

lines.en: Which effective grants allow that? Include inherited and resource-level policies too.
lines.zh: 哪些实际授权允许这样？也包括继承和资源级策略。

lines.en: Okay, I'll take point on this. Just to confirm, no immediate revocation, right?
lines.zh: 好，我来协调。确认一下，不立即撤权，对吧？

lines.en: Correct. First check dependencies and audit coverage. Unused isn't always unnecessary.
lines.zh: 对，先检查依赖和审计覆盖，未使用不总是无需使用。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is old migration access. Monthly reporting may still depend on it.
lines.zh: 当前假设是旧迁移权限，月度报表可能仍依赖它。

lines.en: What's the ETA for job inventory? Maybe a day for owner responses.
lines.zh: 任务清单预计多久？负责人回复可能需要一天。

lines.en: Compare effective permissions with recorded actions. Both views have blind spots.
lines.zh: 对比实际权限和已记录操作，两种视角都有盲点。

lines.en: A fleet-wide identity redesign? Let's park that. Start with export roles.
lines.zh: 整组身份重设计？先放一边，从导出角色开始。

lines.en: Keep emergency recovery dependencies visible. They may not appear in routine logs.
lines.zh: 保留应急恢复依赖，它们可能不出现在日常日志中。

lines.en: I'll contact reporting and recovery owners. Production permissions stay unchanged for now.
lines.zh: 我会联系报表和恢复负责人，生产权限暂时不变。

dialogues.title: 七天日志漏了月底任务
dialogues.premise: 权限清单已汇总，最近七天访问记录未见跨桶写入。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解日志时间窗口与低频依赖之间的差异。

lines.en: One permission dependency appears monthly. The report copies exports into an archive.
lines.zh: 有一项权限依赖每月出现，报表将导出复制到归档。

lines.en: Then seven days won't cover it. Is longer history available?
lines.zh: 那七天覆盖不到，有更长历史吗？

lines.en: The retention policy gives ninety days. I'll check collection gaps before querying.
lines.zh: 保留策略提供九十天，我先查采集空档再查询。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no recorded use isn't enough, right? Ask owners too.
lines.zh: 确认一下，没有使用记录还不够，对吧？也要问负责人。

lines.en: Yes. Simulation helps, but it may miss dynamic resource names.
lines.zh: 对，模拟有帮助，但可能漏掉动态资源名称。

lines.en: I'm on it for archive paths. Maybe quarter-end adds another destination.
lines.zh: 我来核对归档路径，季末可能增加另一个目标。

lines.en: Don't rule that out without evidence. Include failure and recovery workflows.
lines.zh: 没有证据别排除，也要包括失败和恢复流程。

lines.en: Let me play that back. We need actual actions and owner-confirmed dependencies.
lines.zh: 我复述一下，需要实际操作和负责人确认的依赖。

lines.en: Correct. Record uncertainty per permission. A complete-looking spreadsheet can still miss paths.
lines.zh: 对，按权限记录不确定项，看起来完整的表格仍可能漏路径。

lines.en: Okay, wait for that review. The change request must include uncovered cases.
lines.zh: 好，等评审结果，变更申请必须列出未覆盖情况。

dialogues.title: 按任务和前缀拆分
dialogues.premise: 九十天日志覆盖通过，确认日常读取及月底归档写入，失败路径仍需测试。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出角色拆分与资源范围限定的理由。

lines.en: A scoped policy separates reading from archiving. Archive writes use a dedicated role.
lines.zh: 限定策略分开读取与归档，归档写入使用独立角色。

lines.en: Are prefixes enforced on both roles? Separate names alone don't reduce permissions.
lines.zh: 两个角色都强制限定前缀吗？仅名称不同不会缩小权限。

lines.en: Yes, only approved export and archive paths. Dynamic dates stay within those prefixes.
lines.zh: 是，只允许批准的导出和归档路径，动态日期位于这些前缀内。

lines.en: Just to confirm, managed configuration owns the policies, right? No manual drift.
lines.zh: 确认一下，策略由受管配置管理，对吧？不做漂移的手工修改。

lines.en: Yes, with reviewed versions. Prepare a rollback trigger before production changes.
lines.zh: 是，用评审版本，生产变更前准备回退条件。

lines.en: Unexpected denials mean pause expansion. Maybe restore a reviewed specific grant.
lines.zh: 非预期拒绝就暂停扩大，可能恢复经评审的特定授权。

lines.en: Not the blanket policy by default. Restoration needs scope and approval.
lines.zh: 不是默认恢复全权限，恢复也需要范围和审批。

lines.en: Okay, the smoke test covers monthly archives. Failure handling needs separate fixtures.
lines.zh: 好，冒烟测试覆盖月度归档，失败处理需要独立样本。

lines.en: Use a staged rollout with one worker. Keep unaffected workers available.
lines.zh: 从一个工作进程分阶段变更，保留未受影响进程。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll put those gates in review. Business owners must confirm coverage.
lines.zh: 同意，我把门槛列入评审，业务负责人必须确认覆盖。

dialogues.title: 没有调用不代表可以删除
dialogues.premise: 提交角色拆分方案，业务方担心灾备和季末低频路径误伤。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出异议如何改变验证范围而非被忽略。

lines.en: A dormant permission may serve recovery. I don't support deleting it blindly.
lines.zh: 暂未使用权限可能服务恢复，我不支持盲目删除。

lines.en: Fair challenge. Which recovery step needs it? Let's make that dependency explicit.
lines.zh: 这个质疑合理，哪步恢复需要它？把依赖明确化。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis was migration leftovers. I need to revise that claim.
lines.zh: 原假设是迁移遗留，我需要修正那个判断。

lines.en: Just to confirm, evidence first, right? We won't dismiss low-frequency work.
lines.zh: 确认一下，先看证据，对吧？不会忽视低频工作。

lines.en: Recovery access can use a separate controlled role. It needn't remain always active.
lines.zh: 恢复访问可以使用独立受控角色，不必一直启用。

lines.en: Maybe that's workable. Who approves activation when the main owner is unavailable?
lines.zh: 可能可行，主要负责人不在时谁批准启用？

lines.en: Name a backup approver and test response time. Otherwise availability risk grows.
lines.zh: 指定后备审批人并测试响应时间，否则可用性风险增大。

lines.en: We can't rule that out yet. What's the ETA for a recovery rehearsal?
lines.zh: 目前不能排除这个风险，恢复演练预计何时完成？

lines.en: Tomorrow in the test environment. Use equivalent permissions, not production secrets.
lines.zh: 明天在测试环境做，使用等效权限而非生产秘密。

lines.en: Okay, let's park that deletion until rehearsal. Routine role narrowing can proceed to review.
lines.zh: 好，演练前暂缓删除那项权限，日常角色收窄可继续评审。

dialogues.title: 批准范围和例外都写清
dialogues.premise: 恢复演练验证后备审批和独立角色，日常权限收敛具备审批材料。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出批准的是明确批次而非无限扩大。

lines.en: Revocation approval covers one export worker first. The maintenance window starts tonight.
lines.zh: 撤权审批先覆盖一个导出工作进程，维护窗口今晚开始。

lines.en: Does approval include the recovery role? Its activation evidence should be attached.
lines.zh: 审批包括恢复角色吗？应该附上启用证据。

lines.en: Yes, rehearsal passed with the backup approver. Emergency grants expire after use.
lines.zh: 包括，后备审批人的演练通过，应急授权使用后到期。

lines.en: Just to confirm, monthly tests passed, right? Failure fixtures had limited coverage.
lines.zh: 确认一下，月度测试通过，对吧？失败样本覆盖有限。

lines.en: Then record that limit. The first batch needs close denial-log review.
lines.zh: 那就记录限制，首批需要密切检查拒绝日志。

lines.en: Okay, go/no-go depends on that review. Maybe thirty minutes for observation.
lines.zh: 好，继续或停止取决于该评审，可能观察三十分钟。

lines.en: Confirm a rollback trigger for failed exports. New exceptions need security approval.
lines.zh: 确认导出失败的回退条件，新例外要安全审批。

lines.en: Unexpected failures stop expansion immediately. We won't restore all permissions automatically.
lines.zh: 意外失败立即停止扩大，不自动恢复全部权限。

lines.en: Keep the previous policy version available for review. Availability still matters.
lines.zh: 保留旧策略版本供评审，可用性仍重要。

lines.en: Just to recap, narrow first, observe, then decide. I'll watch export completion.
lines.zh: 小结一下，先收窄再观察再决定，我盯导出完成情况。

dialogues.title: 一个工作进程先改
dialogues.premise: 批准首批一个进程收窄权限，保存策略版本，其他进程不变。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分策略写入和实际权限生效。

lines.en: The permission canary has the new policy. Managed configuration recorded its version.
lines.zh: 权限灰度已应用新策略，受管配置记录了版本。

lines.en: Did active sessions refresh? Old grants may survive a policy change.
lines.zh: 活动会话刷新了吗？策略修改后旧授权可能暂时仍有效。

lines.en: The provider confirms new evaluations. A controlled outside-prefix request now rejects.
lines.zh: 提供方确认采用新权限评估，受控前缀外请求现在被拒绝。

lines.en: Just to confirm, only one worker, right? Staged rollout hasn't expanded.
lines.zh: 确认一下，只有一个进程，对吧？分阶段变更还没扩大。

lines.en: Correct. Check legitimate actions too. Denial alone doesn't prove a good policy.
lines.zh: 对。也检查合法操作，仅有拒绝不能证明策略合理。

lines.en: I'm on it for completion checks. Ordinary exports are finishing normally.
lines.zh: 我来检查完成情况，普通导出正常完成。

lines.en: Keep an eye on retries and queue age. Hidden failures can accumulate.
lines.zh: 关注重试和队列等待时间，隐藏失败可能积累。

lines.en: Maybe longer observation helps. Wait through the first scheduled archive run.
lines.zh: 更长观察可能有用，等首个定时归档运行完。

lines.en: I'll correlate denial events with job results. Preserve both successful and rejected requests.
lines.zh: 我关联拒绝事件和任务结果，保存成功及拒绝请求。

lines.en: Okay, I'll add a controlled failure case. Normal exports don't cover quarantine handling.
lines.zh: 好，我加一个受控失败案例，正常导出不覆盖隔离处理。

dialogues.title: 失败隔离路径被误伤
dialogues.premise: 普通导出正常，但受控失败案例触发此前未测试的文件隔离路径。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出预期拒绝与业务误伤如何区分。

lines.en: The failure case gets access denied. It can't write its quarantine record.
lines.zh: 失败案例收到访问拒绝，无法写入隔离记录。

lines.en: Is quarantine a legitimate dependency? Or is the application writing outside scope?
lines.zh: 隔离是合法依赖吗？还是应用写到了范围外？

lines.en: Let me tail the log. The destination belongs to approved failed-export storage.
lines.zh: 我盯一下日志，目标属于批准的失败导出存储。

lines.en: Just to confirm, expansion stops, right? That's our rollback trigger for review.
lines.zh: 确认一下，停止扩大，对吧？这触发回退评审。

lines.en: Yes. Keep unaffected workers available. Don't remove the deliberate outside-prefix denial.
lines.zh: 对，保留未受影响进程，不要取消故意设置的前缀外拒绝。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis was complete path coverage. Correction, quarantine was missed.
lines.zh: 原假设是路径覆盖完整。更正一下，漏掉了隔离路径。

lines.en: That supports a limited repair. Check the required operation, resource, and owner.
lines.zh: 这支持有限修复，核对必要操作、资源和所有者。

lines.en: I'm on it. Maybe a single-prefix write grant is enough for quarantine.
lines.zh: 我来查，隔离可能只需一个前缀的写入授权。

lines.en: Test that proposal before approving it. Broad write access isn't the only fallback.
lines.zh: 批准前测试该方案，广泛写权限不是唯一后备方案。

lines.en: Okay, hold the canary job safely. Document the missed dependency and proposed repair.
lines.zh: 好，安全暂停灰度任务，记录遗漏依赖和拟议修复。

dialogues.title: 只补隔离前缀写权限
dialogues.premise: 确认隔离路径合法且漏列，拟补范围限定的写入例外。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出例外审批、到期与禁止恢复全权限的条件。

lines.en: A narrow exception permits quarantine writes. It doesn't allow listing or other buckets.
lines.zh: 窄范围例外允许隔离写入，不允许列表或其他桶。

lines.en: Who approved it, and when does it expire? Exceptions need lifecycle control.
lines.zh: 谁批准，何时到期？例外需要生命周期管理。

lines.en: Security and the data owner approved seven days. Just to confirm, review before expiry, right?
lines.zh: 安全和数据负责人批准七天，确认一下，到期前评审，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. Permanent dependency needs a reviewed baseline policy, not endless renewals.
lines.zh: 对，永久依赖需要评审基线策略，不是无限续期。

lines.en: The smoke test now quarantines failures. Successful exports still work as expected.
lines.zh: 冒烟测试现在能隔离失败文件，成功导出仍符合预期。

lines.en: Managed configuration records the exception separately. Maybe policy linting can catch excess scope.
lines.zh: 受管配置单独记录例外，策略静态检查可能发现过宽范围。

lines.en: Keep outside-prefix rejection tests. A fix shouldn't silently restore unnecessary access.
lines.zh: 保留前缀外拒绝测试，修复不应悄悄恢复不必要访问。

lines.en: Okay, the rollback trigger remains unexplained failures. No automatic broad-policy restoration.
lines.zh: 好，无法解释的失败仍触发回退评审，不自动恢复广泛策略。

lines.en: Retest monthly archive and recovery paths too. One repaired path isn't full coverage.
lines.zh: 也重测月度归档和恢复路径，修好一条不是完整覆盖。

lines.en: Just to recap, quarantine works with limited access. We'll rerun the complete fixture set.
lines.zh: 小结一下，隔离用有限权限工作，我们重跑全部样本。

dialogues.title: 允许与拒绝都要验证
dialogues.premise: 隔离例外部署后完整样本通过，需独立核实有效权限与剩余批次。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解负向验证以及测试不能证明的边界。

lines.en: Each negative permission test rejects outside scope. Approved workflows still complete successfully.
lines.zh: 每个负向权限测试都拒绝范围外操作，批准流程仍成功完成。

lines.en: Can we rule that out as excess access? Or just the tested operations?
lines.zh: 能排除过宽访问了吗？还是只能排除已测操作？

lines.en: Just tested operations. Effective-policy review also checks inherited grants and session state.
lines.zh: 只是已测操作，实际策略评审还检查继承授权和会话状态。

lines.en: Just to confirm, that review passed, right? Then staged rollout can resume.
lines.zh: 确认一下，那项评审通过，对吧？那分阶段变更可以恢复。

lines.en: Monthly fixtures passed too. Maybe real month-end still reveals timing differences.
lines.zh: 月度样本也通过了，真实月底仍可能显现时间差异。

lines.en: Then let's keep it under observation through month-end. Synthetic coverage has limits.
lines.zh: 那继续观察到月底，合成验证有局限。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on deny counts. Remaining batches use the reviewed version.
lines.zh: 我会关注拒绝计数，剩余批次使用评审版本。

lines.en: Pause if denials diverge by worker. Dynamic paths may differ across instances.
lines.zh: 不同进程拒绝情况分化就暂停，实例间动态路径可能不同。

lines.en: Okay, all batches have completed now. Exports, archives, and quarantine checks pass.
lines.zh: 好，现在所有批次完成，导出、归档和隔离检查通过。

lines.en: Record the final effective policies. Monitoring continues beyond the maintenance window.
lines.zh: 记录最终实际策略，维护窗口后监控继续。

dialogues.title: 例外到期不能靠人记住
dialogues.premise: 全部批次收敛完成，七天隔离例外及月底观察仍需跟进。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出例外如何转入基线或到期收回。

lines.en: Exception expiry is next Tuesday. Who's picking this up before then?
lines.zh: 例外下周二到期，谁在那之前接手？

lines.en: I'll review its necessity Monday. Permanent quarantine access needs a scoped baseline.
lines.zh: 我周一评审必要性，永久隔离访问需要限定基线。

lines.en: My action item is expiry automation. No silent renewal if review slips.
lines.zh: 我的待办是到期自动化，评审延期也不能默默续期。

lines.en: But unexpected expiry can break failure handling. Alert owners before enforcement.
lines.zh: 但意外到期会破坏失败处理，执行前提醒所有者。

lines.en: I'll add quarantine to dependency tests. Maybe that prevents this omission next time.
lines.zh: 我把隔离加入依赖测试，可能防止下次遗漏。

lines.en: Okay, least privilege still needs availability safeguards. Both risks stay documented, right?
lines.zh: 好，最小权限仍需要可用性保护，两种风险都记录，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. We'll close the loop after expiry review and the real monthly run.
lines.zh: 对，到期评审及真实月度运行后完成反馈。

lines.en: Just to recap, no blanket grants remain. The limited exception stays separately tracked.
lines.zh: 小结一下，不再有全权限授权，限定例外单独跟踪。

lines.en: Keep recovery activation rehearsed. Restricted access isn't useful if emergency ownership fails.
lines.zh: 持续演练恢复启用，应急责任失效时限制权限也没有用。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll confirm the next rehearsal date. Today's change closes with follow-up still open.
lines.zh: 同意，我确认下次演练日期，今天变更收尾但跟进仍开放。
